params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Hwei's''' damaging {{tip|abilities}} mark enemies hit for 4 seconds. Subsequent damaging abilities against marked targets consume the mark to create an explosion beneath them, dealing {{as|{{pplevel|40 to 285}}|magic damage}} {{as|(+ 35% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} to enemies in the area after a {{fd|0.85}}-second delay.
params.effect radius: {{tip|er|icononly = true}} {{tt|285|Center of marked champion to edge of other units}}
params.notes:
* The ability that consumes the mark cannot apply it on the same {{tip|cast instance}}.
* The mark '''cannot''' be triggered from the same cast instance of an ability, even if the triggering ability was empowered by ''{{ai|Stirring Lights|Hwei}}''.
* The explosion occurs around the marked target from where they were when the ability damaged them to consume the mark.
** In other words, the explosion is at the location of where they were hit, not where they are at the end of the delay.
*** The target who had their mark consumed is able to escape the area of the explosion within the delay period.
* Enemies can be damaged by multiple explosions at once.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block both the mark and its consumption as well as the detonation.
* The indicator for the effect telegraphs an unusually smaller radius than it actually hits.{{bug|1}}
<!-- Blurb -->

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active - QE:}} {{ci|Hwei}} marks a blazing path in a direction that erupts after a delay into explosions. Each explosion deals {{as|magic damage}} and leaves behind a volcanic fissure that continually deals {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within.
params.description: {{sbc|Active - QE:}} '''Hwei''' marks a blazing path in the target direction. After {{tt|{{fd|0.6}} seconds|From start of cast time}}, the path erupts into volcanic explosions every {{tt|{{fd|0.2}} seconds|Estimated}} from the point of cast, for a total of 7 explosions. Each explosion creates a shockwave that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
params.description2: Each explosion also leaves a lava fissure in its wake. A fissure lasts for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, dealing {{as|magic damage}} every {{fd|0.25}} seconds to enemies within the area and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 35%. Enemies may be damaged by multiple fissures at once.
params.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage per Tick|{{ap|50/10 to 200/10}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60/10}}% AP)}}|Total Fissure Magic Damage|{{ap|50 to 200}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}}}
params.description3: ''Molten Fissure's'' damage is reduced to 60% against {{tip|minions}} and increased to 135% against {{tip|monsters}}.
params.description4: ''Molten Fissure's {{tip|slow}} stacks multiplicatively with the slows applied by {{ai|Grim Visage|Hwei}}, {{ai|Crushing Maw|Hwei}}, and {{ai|Spiraling Despair|Hwei}}.''
params.notes:
* Applies {{tip|area damage}} for the explosions and deals {{tip|persistent area damage}} for the lava.
* The shockwaves can only hit each enemy once.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block an explosion but not the persistent lava damage.

{{st|Initial Shield Strength|{{ap|50 to 130}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}}}}
{{st|Bonus Shield per Tick|{{ap|50/6 to 130/6|round=2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30/6|round=2}}% AP)}}|Total Maximum Shield|{{ap|50*2 to 130*2}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30*2}}% AP)}}}}

** The total amount of shield that can be generated given damage mitigated is far greater than this cap.
* The initial shield amount is inconsistent due to one or two ticks of the bonus shield being granted on-cast.

params.description: {{sbc|Active - EW:}} '''Hwei''' tosses an eyeball to the target location. Upon arrival, it expands over {{fd|0.2}} seconds into a dark gaze that lasts 3 seconds and grants {{tip|sight}} of the {{tt|area|Can see into brush and terrain}}. After {{fd|0.7}} seconds of being placed, the eye locks onto the nearest visible enemy champion or otherwise remains there until an enemy champion is in range. Once locked on, the eye launches itself at the target after a {{fd|0.3}}-second delay and collides with the first enemy hit to deal {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|true sight|reveal}} them for {{fd|2.5}} seconds, and {{tip|root}} them for a duration.

{{st|Root Duration|{{ap|1.2 to 2}} seconds}}
params.notes:
* The target that the eye locks onto and launches towards is {{tip|true sight|revealed}} during the missile's flight.
* The lock-on missile's path is indicated by a dashed line.
** Its launch range is about as wide as its vision range.
** This is not to be confused with the eye's border which is the trigger range.
